quests.title: Small Jack Frost, Big Problems

(test)玩家正与村长交谈（纯镜头）

dialogue.t: (test)与救下来的霜精交谈，获得了送的弹板蓝图$UNRELEASED
(test)呀...呀吼
(test)村子在...采冰镇...北方？
Ya-ho... Ya-ho...
Oh dear, you poor little fella... There, there, we already took care of those big bullies!
Ya-ho—!
Ya-ho... Ya-ho...
Wait, huh? Why are you still looking so down? Could it be because they took your Mora too?

dialogue.sit: It doesn't look like it has pockets, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Mora?
Hmm... Uhh...
Bullied!
Ya-ho! Ya-ho!
Still scared of being bullied? But we already ran those volkodlaks off...
Which means...

dialogue.sit: It actually likes getting bullied?
Or maybe other Jack Frosts are being targeted too.

dialogue.t: Where on earth did you pull that from!
Hey, little guy, are there other friends of yours out there who are still in trouble?
Ya-ho...

dialogue.sit: Waving hands like fluffy snowballs, this Jack Frost rattles its tiny tambourine as it tries to explain how its kin back home are being bullied by volkodlaks...

dialogue.t: Ugh, those volkodlaks are the worst.
If we ever cross paths with your hometown, we'll make sure to teach them a lesson they won't forget!
Ya-ho! Ya-hooo...
Ya-ho...
Oh! Looks like it's finally free.
Still, what are Jack Frosts actually made of anyway? Snow? It was trapped under there for ages, but it didn't even lose its shape...
Ya-ho?
N—no, it's nothing.
Ya... Ya-oh-ho... Ohhhh
Are you okay? Whoa, you made some really weird noises.
Uhh...
Although you don't look too well yet, it doesn't seem to be anything serious...
Ya-ho—! Ya-ho—!
Uh... Is it trying to thank us?
Well, we can't understand a single word you're saying, but... you're welcome?
Ummm...

dialogue.sit:
The somewhat big Jack Frost stares blankly for a second, then...
pulls a wooden slate from behind its back and starts scribbling away with its finger.

dialogue.t: Wait, what's that...? Whoa! You actually know how to write?!
Ya-ho—!
Let Paimon see... "Thank you, good people. I am the village chief."
Wow, the chief! Well, you're welcome, chief.
Ya-ho—!
But wait, "chief" is what you do, not who you are. What's your actual name?
"Village chief."
Ugh, this is getting us nowhere... Let's just stick with "Chief" for now!
Ya-ho—!
So, Chief, what exactly happened around here?
"Volkodlaks. Invaded. Bullied..."
Oh... So they broke into your village and started pushing everyone around?
"Volkodlaks hard. Jack Frosts soft..."
Well... Yeah, their claws do look a whole lot harder than yours... But what are we supposed to do about that?
"Giant snowballs. Launch. Block!"
Wait, can we really block them with just snowballs?

dialogue.sit: Only if we stuff some stones inside...

dialogue.t: Where do you even come up with such terrifying ideas...
Hey! Don't look at him like you just changed its entire worldview! Putting rocks in snowballs is way too dangerous.
But come to think of it, do snowballs even work? If they did, those volkodlaks wouldn't have broken in here in the first place...
"Prime Ice. Hard. Launch. Cannon. Few..."
Oh! So you're trying to build some kind of Prime Ice cannon to launch the snowballs, but you guys ran out of time to assemble the mechanisms?
If that's the case, {NICKNAME}...

dialogue.sit: I guess we could pitch in?

dialogue.t: Yeah! It's not like we haven't crafted our fair share of weird Prime Ice stuffs before...
"Blond hair, big hero! White hair, soft but hard!"
Hey! "Soft but hard" doesn't sound like a compliment at all!
"Come!"
Paimon thinks it wants us to follow it. Let's go see what's up ahead!
"Volkodlak, enter, path."
So... this is the path where the Volkodlak are coming from?

dialogue.sit: Combining the fragmented words on its slate with clumsy gestures, the chief tells you of the attacks that have long plagued their home...

dialogue.t: So you're saying those bad volkodlaks invade this place just to bully you guys every now and then...
And they just stroll right down that path like they own the place,
taking whatever they want and leaving the whole area in a total mess!
Oh, that's just terrible... Those volkodlaks really are the absolute worst!
I get it now! That's why you want to set up those giant snowball cannons right along this path...
And use the giant snowballs to chase them off!
Ya-ho!
"Help cannon!"
Alright, alright, we'll help out with the cannons!
Ya-ho—!
"Ready, Chief, tell!"
Got it, got it. We'll let you know as soon as we're ready!
Ya-ho... Yahoo~
"Ready, Chief, tell!"

dialogue.sit: Yes, we're all set!
Hold on a sec...

dialogue.t: Ya-ho!

dialogue.sit: And so, before the volkodlaks arrive, you wrap up your preparations alongside the Jack Frosts as you set up the defensive fortifications.
Just as expected, it isn't long before a horde of volkodlaks comes into view at the end of the path.

dialogue.t: Alright, now let's see if those prime ice mechanisms are of any use!
D—Darn it, since when did these stupid Jack Frosts become such a pain?
J-Just you wait! We're gonna gather the whole pack and roll you up into snowballs!
We did it! These cannons are pretty awesome!
Ya-ho... Ohhh... Ya-ho—!
Ah, but we can't let our guard down just yet.
The Volkodlak who just fled said they'd be back with backup...
You weren't listening to a single word they said, were you?
*whimper*
"Blond hair, white hair, run!"
We're not exactly scared, are we, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: I'm so scared! Save yourself, Paimon! Run!
I wouldn't be scared even if there were ten times as many.

dialogue.t: Hey! You never miss a chance to be dramatic, do you?!
But anyway, we won't just sit idly by!
Ya-ho!
"Rest? Continue?"
Are you asking us if we want to rest for a while or keep helping with the prep work?
Ya-ho! Ya-ho!

dialogue.sit: Let's keep at it.
Let's get some rest.

dialogue.t: Hmm, well let's see where else we need to place the prime ice mechanisms!
"Volkodlak, enter, path, elsewhere."
So you mean there are other paths they could invade from? Paimon gets it!
{NICKNAME}, let's see where else along those paths we can place the prime ice mechanisms!
"Ready, Chief, tell!"
Got it. Just like before, we'll let you know as soon as we're ready.
"Help cannon?"

dialogue.sit: Let's "help with the cannon"!
We'll be there to help you out later...

dialogue.t: Hmm, well let's see where else we need to place the prime ice mechanisms!
"Volkodlak, enter, path, elsewhere."
Hmm... You mean the volkodlaks will come from other paths, right? Paimon gets it!
{NICKNAME}, let's see where else along those paths we can place the prime ice mechanisms!
"Ready, Chief, tell!"
Got it. Just like before, we'll let you know as soon as we're ready.
"Ready, Chief, tell!"

dialogue.sit: Yes, we're all set!
Hold on a sec...

dialogue.t: Ya-ho!

dialogue.sit: And so, before the volkodlaks arrive for the second time, you wrap up your preparations alongside the Jack Frosts as you set up the defensive fortifications.
It isn't long before a horde of volkodlaks comes into view at the end of the path. In a way, they're quite persistent...

dialogue.t: Hehe! Now every path they take is full of mechanisms!
Ugh, it's not worth it if we keep going like this...
Darn it, I was planning to get my money back this way... Now the money I paid for help has gone up in smoke!
Looks like I'll have to find another way. Hmph! C-Consider yourselves lucky, you Jack Frosts!
That should keep them from ever coming back...
After all, every single path leading in here is already full of prime ice traps and mechanisms.
Ya-ho... *whimpers* Ya-ho—!
Hehe! Paimon got it this time! That was definitely their way of saying thanks.
Don't mention it.
"Finally, complete!"
Huh? What is it up to this time...
"Come!"
It's running off again! Let's catch up and check it out.
Wait, it's the chief, and a whole bunch of Jack Frosts. And what's that they're crowding around...
"Finally, completely!"
What do you mean, "finally, completely"? Paimon doesn't get it at all.
Ya-ho...
"Door, sign, snowball!"
"Fire, fire, fire!"
So you're saying we should... shoot snowballs... at the sign on the door?
"White hair, hard!"
Paimon thinks she gets it now. So "hard" means Paimon is awesome, right?
Ah, "finally, completely" means that when we "finally" finish this, the village will "completely" go back to the way it was... right?
Ya-ho!

dialogue.sit: Ya-ho!
Paimon, hard!

dialogue.t: Paimon knew you were going to do that sooner or later!
Alright, let's help you fix that sign on the door!
Ya-ho!
"Door, sign, snowball!"
"Fire, fire, fire!"
Alright, we know what to do now!
Phew, looks like we've finally fixed up everything damaged by the volkodlaks! They really did a number on this place!
At least it's back to the way it was.
"Thank you!"
Hehe, don't mention it! Seeing your village back to normal makes us super happy too!
But wait... why were those volkodlaks raiding you guys in the first place? From what they was saying, it sounds like there's a ton of valuable stuff hidden around here.
Ya-ho...
"Good. Stuff. Shop!"
So you have some awesome stuff inside your shop? Whoa, Paimon doesn't know why, but it feels like she can understand you perfectly now, chief!
And wait, Paimon never expected this place to actually be a shop! Is it your shop?
"Steal, bad... Trade, good!"
So you're saying those volkodlaks wanted to loot your stuff, but since this is a shop, things are supposed to be traded for?
Oh, so you guys use Mora too?
Wait, it's not Mora?
"Bite-ons."
What is that?
"Blond hair, white hair, good! Give, give!"

dialogue.sit:
The somewhat big Jack Frost reaches behind its back with both hands, pulling out a handful of clinking objects and placing them into your palms.
You instantly recognize them as...

dialogue.t: So that's what you meant by "bite-ons"!

dialogue.sit: Ah, they're buttons!

dialogue.t: "Mora, heavy, bad!"
"Bite-ons, light! Wear, pretty!"
Well, that makes sense. Paimon guesses Jack Frosts don't really have any use for Mora anyway...
So, as long as we find more of these "bite-ons" — uh, buttons — we can use them to trade for stuff at your shop? Is that how this works?
Ya-ho!
Alright! If we find any more of these buttons, we'll definitely bring them straight to you!
"Bite-ons, bite-ons, good!"
Ya-ho ya-ho!

quests.description: While exploring Snezhnaya, you stumble upon a strange settlement of Jack Frosts. They seem to be in the midst of some terrible trouble…
